title: QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing
title_zh: QK-Edit: 重新审视 MM-DiT 中基于注意力的注入机制在图像与视频编辑中的应用

paragraphs.en: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for unified text-vision synthesis, surpassing traditional U-Net architectures in generative tasks. One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention. However, this mechanism poses significant challenges for editing, rendering conventional U-Net-based attention manipulation methods ineffective. To address this limitation, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. By introducing a novel query-key manipulation strategy, our method isolates and adjusts critical attention components to achieve an optimal balance between prompt fidelity and structural consistency. This enables seamless edits across various tasks, including object addition, object removal, object replacement, changing background, changing material, changing color, and style transformation. Notably, it can be easily implemented with feature replacement in inference. QK-Edit demonstrates superior editing performance on state-of-the-art models, such as FLUX and HunyuanVideo, effectively bridging the gap between generative power and editable flexibility in MM-DiTs, and paving the way for scalable multimodal content creation.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态扩散变换器（MM-DiTs）最近已成为统一文本与视觉合成的强大框架，在生成任务中超越了传统的 U-Net 架构。 其关键创新之一在于多模态自注意力（MM-SA）交互机制：图像和文本的 token 被拼接并通过自注意力进行处理。 然而，这一机制给编辑带来了重大挑战，使得传统的基于 U-Net 的注意力操控方法失效。 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了 QK-Edit——一个无需训练的框架，它利用 MM-DiTs 独特的注意力动态特性，实现精准的文本引导图像与视频编辑。 通过引入一种新颖的查询-键操控策略，我们的方法能够隔离并调整关键的注意力组件，从而在提示保真度与结构一致性之间达到最佳平衡。 这使得该方法能够无缝执行多种任务，包括添加物体、移除物体、替换物体、更改背景、更改材质、更改颜色以及风格转换。 值得注意的是，该方法在推理阶段通过特征替换即可轻松实现。 QK-Edit 在 FLUX 和 HunyuanVideo 等顶尖模型上展现出卓越的编辑性能，有效弥合了 MM-DiTs 在生成能力与编辑灵活性之间的差距，并为可扩展的多模态内容创作开辟了道路。

paragraphs.en: The emergence of Transformer-based diffusion models [ 50 ] , particularly Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) [ 5 , 16 , 34 , 70 ] , has redefined the landscape of generative models for image and video synthesis. Unlike U-Net architectures [ 55 ] , which separate text-vision Cross-Attention (CA) and vision-vision Self-Attention (SA), MM-DiTs leverage a Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) mechanism to process multimodal inputs in a unified embedding space. MM-SA concatenates text and vision embeddings and computes self-attention on the joint embedding 1 1 1 In this paper, “vision” refers to video or image data. . This integration enables nuanced and coherent outputs, making MM-DiTs a cornerstone in models such as FLUX [ 5 ] , Stable Diffusion 3.0 [ 16 ] , HunyuanVideo [ 34 ] , and CogVideo-X [ 70 ] . However, MM-SA introduces complexities that challenge existing editing paradigms based on attention manipulation [ 22 , 61 ] . Specifically, due to the joint attention mechanism, textual and visual interactions become deeply intertwined within a single attention matrix, complicating the independent manipulation of textual and visual information. As a result, such editing methods for U-Net models become ineffective in Fig. 2 .

paragraphs.en: These complexities arise because such previous editing methods rely heavily on the modular nature of U-Net architectures [ 54 ] , where cross-attention facilitates precise text-guided modifications, and self-attention ensures spatial consistency. In contrast, MM-DiTs integrate these attention mechanisms into a unified structure, making it challenging to independently control text-vision and vision-vision interactions without one adversely affecting the other. A naive solution is to decompose the MM-SA map into four quadrants, each representing a specific interaction between text and vision embeddings and directly apply previous CA-based or SA-based editing techniques such as P2P [ 22 ] or PnP [ 61 ] to the respective attention maps. However, this often leads to undesirable outputs, as illustrated in Fig. 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 这些复杂性的出现，是因为以往的编辑方法严重依赖 U-Net 架构的模块化特性 [54]：其中，交叉注意力有助于实现精确的文本引导修改，而自注意力则能确保空间一致性。 相比之下，MM-DiTs 将这些注意力机制整合到一个统一结构中，因此很难独立控制文本-视觉与视觉-视觉之间的交互，而不使两者相互产生负面影响。 一种简单的解决方案是将 MM-SA 图分解为四个象限，每个象限分别表示文本嵌入与视觉嵌入之间的特定交互，然后直接对相应的注意力图应用基于 CA 或 SA 的先前编辑技术，例如 P2P [22] 或 PnP [61]。 然而，这种方法常常导致不理想的结果，如图 2 所示。

paragraphs.en: Through systematic analysis, we observe: (1) text-to-vision attention has negligible impact on the final generation, (2) vision-to-text attention relates vision region to the text token, and finally (3) vision-vision attention defines both spatial and temporal consistency within visual embeddings. As a result, simultaneous replacement of vision-to-text and vision-to-vision attention is necessary to enable precise control over spatial and temporal properties while adhering to the target prompt. Building upon these insights, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free editing framework that manipulates the attention quadrants of MM-DiTs to achieve high-fidelity edits. In practice, we leverage the fact that text-to-vision attention has minimal impact on the generation and replace the vision component in query and key embeddings of the target image or video with that of the source image or video during the denoising process. In practice, our proposed strategy is straightforward to implement, requiring only minimal code modifications.
paragraphs.zh: 通过系统性分析，我们观察到：(1) 文本到视觉注意力对最终生成结果的影响可以忽略不计；(2) 视觉到文本注意力将视觉区域与文本标记关联起来；最后 (3) 视觉到视觉注意力决定了视觉嵌入中的空间一致性和时间一致性。 因此，必须同时替换视觉到文本注意力和视觉到视觉注意力，以便在遵循目标提示的同时，对空间和时间的特性进行精确控制。 基于这些见解，我们提出了 QK-Edit——一个无需训练的编辑框架，通过调整 MM-DiTs 的注意力象限来实现高保真度的编辑。 在实际应用中，我们利用了文本到视觉注意力对生成结果影响极小这一特性，并在去噪过程中将目标图像或视频的查询和键嵌入中的视觉部分替换为源图像或视频对应的部分。 实际上，我们提出的策略易于实施，仅需对代码进行最小程度的修改。

paragraphs.en: Our QK-Edit can be seamlessly extended to image and video domains, demonstrating its versatility in various generative tasks. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of QK-Edit on state-of-the-art models such as FLUX [ 5 ] and HunyuanVideo [ 34 ] , achieving superior results in tasks ranging from object-level modifications to global scene transformations. Notably, our method enables high-resolution, long-frame video editing with spatio-temporal consistency, overcoming the limitations of previous editing approaches. Furthermore, the training-free nature of QK-Edit ensures computational efficiency and broad applicability. QK-Edit represents a pivotal step in bridging the gap between the generative power and editable flexibility of Transformer-based diffusion models.

paragraphs.en: From U-Net to MM-DiT in Diffusion Models. We revisit diffusion models, which underpin most recent editing methods. The U-Net architecture [ 55 , 51 ] has been extensively studied in generative models, as seen in Lumiere [ 4 ] for text-to-video synthesis and Stable Diffusion [ 54 ] for text-to-image generation. Recently, Transformer-based diffusion models have gained attention for capturing long-range dependencies and multimodal interactions. For instance, Peebles and Xie [ 50 ] introduce the Diffusion Transformer (DiT), replacing U-Net with a Vision Transformer (ViT) for improved results, while Chen et al. [ 13 ] propose GenTron to overcome CNN-based U-Net limitations. Multimodal extensions, such as MM-DiT [ 16 , 5 ] , integrate text and vision embeddings to enable sophisticated multi-prompt generation tasks [ 10 ] . For video generative models, following Sora [ 48 ] , several works [ 60 , 34 , 40 ] have open-sourced video diffusion models like Hunyuan Video [ 34 ] and CogVideoX [ 70 ] . These advances illustrate an evolution from U-Net to Transformer-based frameworks, offering enhanced scalability, flexibility, and performance. Our training-free technique offers a fast and low-cost solution to unlock the inherent editing potential of these MM-DiT-based new-generation models.
paragraphs.zh: 从 U-Net 到扩散模型中的 MM-DiT。 我们重新审视了扩散模型，它是大多数近期编辑方法的基础。 U-Net 架构 [ 55 , 51 ] 在生成模型中得到了广泛研究，例如 Lumiere [ 4 ] 用于文本到视频合成，以及 Stable Diffusion [ 54 ] 用于文本到图像生成。 最近，基于 Transformer 的扩散模型因其能够捕捉长程依赖和多模态交互而受到关注。 例如，Peebles 和 Xie [ 50 ] 提出了扩散 Transformer（DiT），用视觉 Transformer（ViT）替代 U-Net 以提升效果，而 Chen 等人 [ 13 ] 则提出 GenTron 以克服基于 CNN 的 U-Net 的局限性。 多模态扩展技术，如 MM-DiT [ 16 , 5 ] ，整合了文本和视觉嵌入，从而支持复杂的多提示生成任务 [ 10 ] 。 在视频生成模型方面，继 Sora [ 48 ] 之后，多项研究 [ 60 , 34 , 40 ] 已将 Hunyuan Video [ 34 ] 和 CogVideoX [ 70 ] 等视频扩散模型开源。 这些进展表明，技术正从 U-Net 向基于 Transformer 的框架演进，带来了更强的可扩展性、灵活性和性能。 我们的无训练技术提供了一种快速且低成本的方法，能够释放这些基于 MM-DiT 的新世代模型所固有的编辑潜力。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-based Image Editing. Recent image editing advances fall into training-free and training-based approaches. Training-free methods use pre-trained generative models for direct image manipulation, avoiding costly training [ 44 , 29 , 8 , 30 , 22 , 2 , 62 , 21 , 59 , 37 , 26 , 41 , 69 ] . They mainly include inversion-based and direct manipulation-based techniques. Inversion-based methods, such as Null-Text Inversion [ 45 ] , StyleDiffusion [ 65 ] and KV Inversion [ 24 ] encode images into a generative model’s latent space, where edits adjust latent representations. Other methods, such as pix2pix-zero [ 49 ] and SEGA [ 7 ] , modify latent features or noise maps using attention and blending, enabling precise and efficient editing. In contrast, training-based approaches [ 32 , 28 , 72 , 73 , 19 , 53 , 12 , 47 , 63 , 36 , 67 , 25 , 38 ] enhance editing capabilities by fine-tuning generative models or training auxiliary networks on task-specific datasets [ 72 , 9 , 27 ] . These approaches generally offer stronger semantic fidelity and improved visual quality at the cost of additional computational overhead. Methods like InstructPix2Pix [ 9 ] and MagicBrush [ 72 ] employ instruction-based editing by fine-tuning generative models to directly map textual instructions and input images to edited outputs. Our QK-Edit, built on MM-DiT architectures, requires no extra training while efficiently unlocking new-generation models’ editing potential for high prompt fidelity and structural consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 基于扩散的图像编辑。 近期的图像编辑进展可分为无需训练和基于训练的方法。 无需训练的方法利用预训练的生成模型直接进行图像操作，从而避免了昂贵的训练过程 [ 44 , 29 , 8 , 30 , 22 , 2 , 62 , 21 , 59 , 37 , 26 , 41 , 69 ] 。 这些方法主要包括基于反演和基于直接操作的技术。 基于反演的方法，如 Null-Text Inversion [ 45 ]、StyleDiffusion [ 65 ] 和 KV Inversion [ 24 ]，将图像编码到生成模型的潜在空间中，并通过调整潜在表示来实现编辑。 其他方法，如 pix2pix-zero [ 49 ] 和 SEGA [ 7 ]，利用注意力和混合技术修改潜在特征或噪声图，从而实现精确高效的编辑。 相比之下，基于训练的方法 [ 32 , 28 , 72 , 73 , 19 , 53 , 12 , 47 , 63 , 36 , 67 , 25 , 38 ] 通过微调生成模型或在特定任务数据集上训练辅助网络来增强编辑能力 [ 72 , 9 , 27 ] 。 这些方法通常能提供更强的语义保真度和更优的视觉质量，但需要额外的计算开销。 像 InstructPix2Pix [ 9 ] 和 MagicBrush [ 72 ] 这样的方法采用基于指令的编辑方式，通过微调生成模型，将文本指令和输入图像直接映射到编辑后的输出。 我们的 QK-Edit 基于 MM-DiT 架构构建，无需额外训练，却能高效释放新一代模型的编辑潜力，实现高提示保真度和结构一致性。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-based Video Editing. Diffusion-based Video Editing. Training-free methods [ 29 , 3 , 43 , 64 , 52 , 57 ] leverage pre-trained diffusion models and latent manipulation to avoid extensive training. For example, Video-P2P [ 43 ] and Vid2Vid-Zero [ 64 ] extend the image-based P2P [ 22 ] framework to video by injecting attention maps and using latent inversion for temporal consistency, while Fate-Zero [ 52 ] enhances spatial coherence by selectively injecting SA and CA maps from the reconstruction branch. Similarly, Edit-A-Video [ 57 ] and Make-A-Protagonist [ 75 ] refine latent manipulations with explicit semantic masks or advanced attention mechanisms, improving temporal stability without extra training. In contrast, training-based approaches [ 18 , 58 , 76 , 42 , 6 , 14 ] fine-tune models specifically for video data [ 14 , 20 , 1 , 23 , 18 ] , significantly boosting editing performance at the cost of increased computation. Tune-A-Video [ 66 ] fine-tunes spatial and temporal attention layers for consistency, while MotionDirector [ 74 ] and Dreamix [ 46 ] employ decoupled motion and appearance fine-tuning to reduce artifacts. ControlNet-based methods, such as MagicEdit [ 39 ] and Ground-A-Video [ 71 ] , use depth maps and bounding boxes to guide edits for improved semantic and temporal coherence, and InsV2 [ 14 ] leverages motion compensation with instruction-based fine-tuning to handle longer videos with enhanced continuity. Our QK-Edit can easily generalize to video editing for MM-DiT-based video generative models [ 34 , 70 ] .

paragraphs.en: We implement QK-Edit on state-of-the-art MM-DiT-based generative models. Specifically, we use FLUX.1-dev [ 5 ] and HunyuanVideo [ 34 ] as base model for image and video editing, respectively. For image editing, we apply our query-key manipulation during the first 30% diffusion inference steps. For video editing, resolutions vary between 320 × \times 320 (with 65 frames) and 1280 × \times 720 (up to 129 frames). We apply query-key manipulation during the first 20% of inference steps, which empirically provides optimal temporal consistency and editing fidelity. All experiments are conducted on NVIDIA A100 GPUs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在基于 MM-DiT 的当前最先进生成模型上实现了 QK-Edit。 具体来说，我们分别使用 FLUX.1-dev [ 5 ] 和 HunyuanVideo [ 34 ] 作为图像和视频编辑的基础模型。 对于图像编辑，我们在扩散推理的前 30% 步骤中应用我们的查询-键操作。 对于视频编辑，分辨率在 320 × \times 320（65 帧）和 1280 × \times 720（最多 129 帧）之间变化。 我们在推理步骤的前 20% 期间应用查询-键操作，经验表明这能实现最佳的时间一致性和编辑保真度。 所有实验均在 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上进行。

paragraphs.en: To rigorously assess editing performance, we utilize the following metrics following previous works [ 68 , 33 , 58 , 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了严格评估编辑性能，我们遵循先前的研究 [ 68 , 33 , 58 , 18 ] ，采用以下指标。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, for image editing, we employ CLIP text {}_{\text{text}} (measures semantic alignment between the edited image and the text prompt), DINO (perceptual similarity for structure-alignment) and PickScore (assesses overall editing quality and realism in a human-like manner).
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，在图像编辑方面，我们采用了 CLIP 文本 {}_{\text{text}}（用于衡量编辑后的图像与文本提示之间的语义对齐程度）、DINO（用于结构对齐的感知相似度）以及 PickScore（以类人的方式评估整体编辑质量和真实感）。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, to evaluate video editing performance, we use CLIP frames {}_{\text{frames}} (computes frame consistency through the average cosine similarity across all video frames), PickScore (assesses the predicted human preference averaged over all video frames), ViCLIP dir {}_{\text{dir}} (measures directional video-text alignment) and ViCLIP out {}_{\text{out}} (evaluates overall video-text alignment).
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，为了评估视频编辑性能，我们使用 CLIP 帧 {}_{\text{frames}}（通过所有视频帧的平均余弦相似度计算帧间一致性）、PickScore（评估预测的人类偏好，并在所有视频帧上取平均值）、ViCLIP dir {}_{\text{dir}}（衡量视频与文本的方向性对齐）以及 ViCLIP out {}_{\text{out}}（评估视频与文本的整体对齐）。

Recognizing the growing demand for high-fidelity video editing, we introduce a new benchmark, HiLo-Benchmark, consisting of 43 carefully selected challenging videos with resolutions exceeding 1K and sequences longer than 100 frames. This benchmark specifically evaluates the ability of video editing methods to handle extended and high-resolution content. For baselines, considering compatibility with high-resolution and long-duration video generation, we adapt ideas from previous image/video synthesis frameworks and reimplement them based on HunyuanVideo [ 34 ] . Our proposed benchmark includes comparisons with methods such as KV concat {}_{\text{concat}} (MasaCtrl [ 11 ] and Tune-a-video [ 66 ] ), V replace {}_{\text{replace}} (RF-Solver [ 62 ] ) and KV replace {}_{\text{replace}} (Stable Flow [ 2 ] ). paragraphs.en: In this work, we present QK-Edit, a simple yet effective training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate the versatility of QK-Edit across a wide range of editing tasks, e.g . , object addition, object removal, object replacement, changing background, changing material, changing color, and style transformation etc . More importantly, it can be easily implemented with a few lines of code.

paragraphs.en: Limitation and future work. While QK-Edit significantly advances training-free text-guided editing for MM-DiTs, it still exhibits several limitations. First, the accuracy of real video inversion remains challenging, particularly in complex scenes with intricate motions, which can compromise subsequent editing results. Second, QK-Edit inevitably introduces minor unintended modifications in regions that should remain unaltered; future work could incorporate masks to better preserve these areas. Third, as a training-free approach, QK-Edit inherits the limitations of its base generative model, such as suboptimal text rendering and structural deficiencies in handling complex motions (e.g., gymnastic videos). These issues might be alleviated by employing more advanced generative models, which we leave as a promising direction for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性与未来工作。 尽管 QK-Edit 在无训练的情况下显著推进了基于文本的 MM-DiTs 编辑，但它仍然存在一些局限性。 首先，真实视频的反向生成准确性仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在包含复杂动作的场景中，这可能会影响后续的编辑结果。 其次，QK-Edit 不可避免地会在本应保持不变的区域引入轻微的意外修改；未来的工作可以结合掩码来更好地保留这些区域。 第三，作为一种无需训练的方法，QK-Edit 继承了其基础生成模型的局限性，例如文本渲染效果不佳以及处理复杂动作（如体操视频）时的结构缺陷。 这些问题或许可以通过采用更先进的生成模型得到缓解，我们将其作为未来研究的一个有前景的方向。
